title: nidema boothii
intro: Nidema boothii, commonly known as Himalayan Balsam, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Himalayas and parts of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Balsam include its ability to act as a diuretic, lowering blood pressure and improving digestion. The bioactive constituents of Nidema boothii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
